title: esula cyparissias
intro: Esula cyparissias, commonly known as Hound's-tongue, is a perennial plant in the borage family native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Esula cyparissias include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
